title: Interview session capture
note: Field reference for the adapter. Deliberately has no field for an individual's name, email, or account; the loader refuses a file carrying one at any depth.

session.session_source_id: source_id of these notes in the source register

notes.corroborating_artifact: source_id or null; an interview record is refused

statuses.ILLUSTRATED: statement plus a specific example; supports_finding = false
statuses.CORROBORATED: statement plus a resolving artifact; supports_finding = true
statuses.DISPUTED: contradicted by another note; supports_finding = false, both retained
